mapper.insert: insert into booknest.`ai_message`(id, conversation_id, role, content, token_count, tool_calls, recommendations, model, is_error, create_time) values (#{id}, #{conversationId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{tokenCount}, #{toolCalls}, #{recommendations}, #{model}, #{isError}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select * from booknest.`ai_message` where conversation_id = #{conversationId} order by create_time asc
select * from booknest.`ai_message` where conversation_id = #{conversationId} order by create_time desc limit #{limit}
